title: Printr cross-chain launchpad — live unprivileged extraction screen
closed_reasons: Treasury withdraw is gated on an immutable printr address = the core proxy (0xb77726...): attacker -> WrongAccess(), core -> success (fork-proven; same for legacy treasury)
Admin surface (pause/unpause/transferOwnership/renounceOwnership/upgradeToAndCall/updateGlobalProtocols) reverts OwnableUnauthorizedAccount for unprivileged callers; owner is EOA 0x8dd1886b...c273

Cross-chain mint path receiveFromChannel requires CREATE3 channel + protocol==2 + hard-coded Solana peer 0x27289e1d...3b5f (fork-proven: wrong peer -> UnauthorizedCaller, correct peer -> reaches parser)
Bonding-curve buy/sell math charges 1% each way with protocol-favouring rounding; buy->sell round trip always ends below start (fork-proven on 3 live Ethereum curves)
collectProtocolFees/collectLiquidityFees are permissionless to trigger but pay only protocol funds/creator NFT owner/stakers; attacker deltas = 0 (fork-proven)
printrDev creator-NFT mint from attacker reverts 0x878d41a8; telecoin teleportIn/Out are core-gated; permitWitnessCall binds the full call into the signed witness
key_facts: Same proxy 0xb77726291b125515d0a7affeea2b04f2ff243172 on all EVM chains (PrintrProxy ERC1967); impl/teleport/module are unverified and were audited via decompilation + live/fork execution

Treasury 0x8c843012b347664caf84b907053754208a933fee holds the curve reserves: ETH $10,485 (4.2646 WETH), Base $3,912, BSC $6,093 (8.28 WBNB), Avalanche $3,114 (312 WAVAX), Monad $6,149 (253,980 WMON), Mantle $10,970 (21,050 WMNT), Arbitrum ~$515 => ~$41.2k total (GoldRush 2026-10-14)
All four fee funds on Ethereum point at one address 0x65f7a87c6e055f55edd81fc01eee506f66acd4ab; tradingFee=1%, fee split team 70%/creator 30%
Only the LZ_FAST channel (0x69b20d72...c384) is deployed on Ethereum; LZ_SECURE/SLOW channels have no code
Legacy treasury 0xde420c83...1549 and the staking contract 0x49336345...b5d5 hold only dust ($0 / $0.02 on Base)
Measured accumulated protocol fees on 3 sampled Ethereum telecoins: 0.000659 / 0.013980 / 0.000637 WETH (~$38 total); unmeasured elsewhere, small
caveats: Deployed impl/teleport/module are unverified; conclusions rest on selectors, heimdall/evmole decompilation and live eth_call + fork execution of the deployed bytecode
Arbitrum treasury value ($515) carried from triage row (GoldRush HTTP 552 during this run)
P (protocol fees) only sampled on 3 Ethereum tokens; no full enumeration of 5,343 telecoins
Solana leg out of scope (EVM-focused screen)
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live from Printr; ~$41.2k is bonding-curve reserve redeemable by telecoin holders (H-O), and every privileged/cross-chain/admin path is correctly gated and fork-verified
